reason: If the first order really is all cash on delivery, I lose nothing by trying, so I'd send a few links for the kids' clothes and some small house things. I already wait weeks with my Instagram page, so the wait doesn't scare me.
objection: After the first order they want 30% up front, and I don't know this name. My Instagram page I've used for a year; a new company can disappear with my deposit, and 21,000 in fees on one kilo is a lot when the items themselves are cheap.
would_change_my_mind: If the first cash-on-delivery order arrived late, or the final price at the door was different from the quote, I would not order again.
